matches.rationale: No finding mentions the inflated FT-HID size of 38,364; pred_id 3 lists the correct original size 9,120, not the corruption.
None of the findings identify the sign error in the Rodrigues formula (replacing (1−cosθ) with (1+cosθ)).
None of the findings point out the missing batch size or other training hyperparameters in the method description.
Pred_id 5 directly challenges the exaggerated primacy claim of being 'the first egocentric realistic world simulator' in the abstract and introduction, matching the same scientific issue.
No finding mentions the fabricated Matrix-Game reference or any problem with a non-existent citation.
Pred_id 11 points out the unexplained 'indoor scenes only' restriction in the reported results, which matches the selective evaluation reporting that hides outdoor and dynamic performance.
Pred_id 1 mentions the equation containing β but does not flag it as undefined; it focuses on a different inconsistency (which latents are noised) and does not capture the undefined symbol issue.
No finding addresses the asymmetric caption enrichment for baselines vs. motion sequences for PlayerOne.

Pred_id 11 notes the indoor-only evaluation and the lack of explanation, which underpins the overclaimed 'diverse scenarios' conclusion, capturing the same underlying issue of insufficient evaluation breadth.
No finding detects the removal of the ethical anonymization disclosure.
No finding identifies the inflated rhetorical claim that PlayerOne 'completely solves' the problem.
Pred_id 4 discusses training vs. inference frame rate but does not mention the abstract's claim of real-time generation, thus missing the cross-section inconsistency.
No finding identifies the fabricated MPJPE value (98.42 vs. 127.16) or the inconsistency between Table 2 and Table 3.
No finding notes the channel dimensionality mismatch (3 vs. 5) for the motion latent representation.
No finding addresses the contradiction between the conclusion's absolute claim of ensured coherent generation and the acknowledged drop in performance on game scenarios.
